results.name: Blowfish constants computed from π match the published first/last words; bcrypt_pbkdf == python bcrypt.kdf
Poly1305 (13-bit limbs) == cryptography's Poly1305 on 40 random (key, message) pairs incl. block edges
OpenSSH key files written by ssh-keygen: encrypted ed25519 (bcrypt+aes256-ctr), RSA-3072 (aes256-gcm), ECDSA-384, PEM P-521
generated ed25519 keys (plain and passphrase-encrypted) are read by ssh-keygen and sign for real logins
every KEX × cipher × MAC × host-key algorithm negotiates with asyncssh and runs a command
auth: password (retry after a wrong one), banner, every public key type, keyboard-interactive, all-fail
host key: a rejection (unknown / changed) aborts BEFORE authentication; nothing is sent after
pty shell: TERM/size/env reach the server, typed lines echo, window-change resizes, exit status 3
exec: exit codes, stderr, signals (exit-signal), unknown command 127, several channels at once
10 MiB each way with flow control: download hash == server's, upload hash == server's; stats count it
rekeying: server-initiated (every 1 MiB) and client-initiated (every 512 KiB) during 10 MiB transfers, strict KEX
SFTP v3: realpath, mkdir, 3 MiB pipelined upload/download byte-identical, stat, list, rename, symlink, errors
Terrapin-style injection: an IGNORE before the server's KEXINIT aborts a strict-KEX session (accepted only when strict is off)
strict KEX: an IGNORE injected AFTER the server's KEXINIT (inside the initial key exchange) aborts with strict-kex
a different host key presented at a REKEY aborts the session (hostkey-changed), even though that key belongs to the same server
MAC / AEAD tampering: one flipped bit after the handshake kills the connection for every cipher+MAC mode; no corrupted byte is delivered
a server sending an all-zero curve25519 point is refused (RFC 8731 §3), before any signature work
known_hosts: plain, [host]:port, wildcard/negation, @revoked, @cert-authority ignored; hashed by ssh-keygen -H is matched
